623.head: a4c6de78d867d9e99ee596c15251ac7d4a522737
623.title: docs: cross-platform Rust roadmap, COM boundaries and targeted Python reduction
623.body:
## Purpose and scope

Keep the cross-platform Rust roadmap, Windows COM (Component Object Model) boundaries and targeted reduction of Python wrappers tied to actual consumers and measurable requirements. The roadmap separates process ownership, identity observations, language boundaries, protected reading and workload measurement. A useful Go correction does not establish a reason to migrate the product to Rust.

This documentation branch records the six-stage execution board and evidence for independently reviewed code PRs. It does not import those product changes or turn their focused checks into acceptance of a combined product. The captured pre-R24 head is `0fac6a5e992ec8b4937bad9fa7d71e64d711b3af`.

## R24 continuation

Published five scoped consolidations and the two-line #631 README correction. Closed #639 → #647, #645/#651 → #643, #656 → #650 and #636 → #637: readbacks confirm `merged:false`, with source branches retained. #637 now targets #635 (30 changed files). The repository-wide snapshot at **14:30 MSK (11:30 UTC), 21 November 2026** confirmed **26 open PRs, all Draft**, down from 31.

All **15 prepare/qualify/build-vet phases** completed. The 11 selected race-test commands recorded **57 required root PASS executions**, **305 test/subtest PASS + 11 package PASS**, and zero FAIL/SKIP. Ten full build/vet commands exited 0. These are exact-source-plus-overlay results, not whole-published-head tests or a full `go test ./...`.

**Published documentation checkpoint: b21402535ac4df032408d7bf06200ddd0557abf1.** The compact R24 audit replaces repeated status appendices with explicit scope, source identities, preserved outcomes and remaining work. The previous descriptions remain available in the archive below. The closed donors retain their changes and evidence in the responsible destinations; no PR merge occurred.

## Preserved historical checkpoint

[The immutable R22/R23 evidence set](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b1d932ea8925ef3324d539e5de006daeae65ba2a/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r22-r23-2026-11-21/README.md) records exact source commits and file overlays, not a new full run of every later PR head:

- R22 contains 36 phases, including negative controls and the retained Relay v1 FAIL. Of 2,128 original stdout/stderr streams, 2,117 original hashes can be recomputed from public bytes; 11 redacted streams have distinct public hashes.
- R23 current Scheduler-mutation control: 16 test FAIL plus package FAIL; candidate: 16 test PASS plus package PASS. The adjacent wrapper remains FAILED despite 77 test PASS and package PASS: one explicit platform-only SKIP occurred on Windows.
- Separate Rust debug inputs produced 53 and 76 native terminal checks, 20 foreign-function-interface checks, and the final Go consumer's 129 test/subtest PASS events representing 118 terminal cases. These counts describe different selections and must not be added into one coverage total.
- Four nonexecuting inventories on `f12932bcca6c288d062f9affd32ea58a7c9eb74f` listed API normal/tagged 3,437/3,443 roots and CLI 1,960/1,963. Test bodies were not run; 3,216 tracked files matched before/after. Inventory does not replace the preserved full-suite FAIL results.

## Remaining acceptance

Representative workloads and budgets, native process and Scheduler boundaries, full credentials/ownership policy, reader #627 prerequisites, installed-product scenarios and complete Go gates remain separately tracked in #658. Previous FAIL and NOT_RUN outcomes stay open unless a new scoped receipt resolves them. Documentation cleanup alone establishes neither a fresh full source review nor a new runtime PASS, Rust migration readiness or formal external approval. This PR remains Draft.

## Evidence archive

[R24 audit and source manifests](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b21402535ac4df032408d7bf06200ddd0557abf1/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r24-2026-11-21/README.md) · [Original PR descriptions, preserved verbatim](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b21402535ac4df032408d7bf06200ddd0557abf1/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r24-2026-11-21/original-pr-descriptions.zip). The archive retains the complete historical narrative, failed attempts and original source references; earlier results remain limited to those inputs.

624.head: 81dcf67db013ba2879878c2ee6fe07aa0bb4aec3
624.title: test(perf): expand CMake trace benchmarks through bounded public output
624.body:
## Problem and behavior

CMake trace measurements must include the bounded public response used by `vcpkg_cmake_trace`, rather than treating an unrestricted internal Result as the wire response. This PR retains the benchmark/contract suite and clears the discarded tail of `Records`, so trimmed records no longer retain their argument strings through the backing array. Public output semantics remain separately checked.

Source head: `81dcf67db013ba2879878c2ee6fe07aa0bb4aec3`. The benchmark covers 9 synthetic inputs and 4 stages: parsing, file/index/result construction, bounded serialization of a prepared result, and file-to-bounded-JSON processing. It does not measure the full Model Context Protocol (MCP) handler, network delivery or the external CMake process.

## Historical verification

[R22 evidence](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b1d932ea8925ef3324d539e5de006daeae65ba2a/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r22-r23-2026-11-21/README.md) uses exact source `251fb4f03405ba438662976137afec0d9c27105e` plus pinned Go file overlays; candidate blobs matched the published files. It is not a full execution of the later head.

- Negative control: 1 test PASS, 6 test FAIL and package FAIL. Candidate: 14 test PASS plus package PASS; adjacent selection: 6 plus package PASS. Build and vet exited 0.
- Three consumer scenarios on a trace produced by real CMake retained byte-identical public JSON before/after. Discarded-tail argument references decreased from 33,275 / 31,339 / 33,265 to zero. Each contract phase had 4 test PASS plus package PASS.
- Three benchmark scenarios completed one iteration each. This establishes executable workloads, not a speedup or accepted performance budget.

[The earlier measurement report](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/251fb4f03405ba438662976137afec0d9c27105e/docs/modernization/verification/cmaketrace-2026-11-18/RESULTS.md) applies to clean measured source `87bf2fe6d612de296d4f30a8a5087adb8ee5cdbc`: 36 smoke combinations and 40 main samples; 135 root and 45 nested PASS events under `-race -count=3`, with no FAIL/SKIP. Repeated 50,000-record medians were 84.260 ms parse, 99.811 ms file/index, 0.245 ms prepared public JSON and 100.140 ms file-to-JSON. The 0.245 ms projection omits all four large collections; it is not delivery of 1,000 records to a client.

## Limits and R24 status

Reference counts are not unique heap size. Warm-cache synthetic timings, one-iteration real-trace checks and measurements from different hosts are not a before/after comparison or evidence of a Rust advantage. Peak parse/index memory, consumer retention, representative concurrency, end-to-end delivery and agreed budgets remain open. Previous general FAIL/NOT_RUN gates are unchanged.

R24 changes this description only; unchanged runtime was not rerun for freshness. No new full-head PASS or formal external approval is asserted. Keep Draft and retain this measurement/consumer responsibility separately from Relay and native process observation.

## Evidence archive

[R24 audit and source manifests](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b21402535ac4df032408d7bf06200ddd0557abf1/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r24-2026-11-21/README.md) · [Original PR descriptions, preserved verbatim](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/b21402535ac4df032408d7bf06200ddd0557abf1/docs/modernization/verification/completion-r24-2026-11-21/original-pr-descriptions.zip). The archive retains the complete historical narrative, failed attempts and original source references; earlier results remain limited to those inputs.

627.head: b827398ef127a1556b7b2bdcdcec7fe03fa6651d
627.title: spike(rust): anchored verified file reader with native replacement and cap tests
627.body:
## Актуальное ревью — 18 ноября 2026

**HEAD: `b827398ef127a1556b7b2bdcdcec7fe03fa6651d`; Draft. Master checkpoint: `a7d92d2852c4f6eb8afb0569ef76a545e38aacf7`.**

Завершено узкое сопоставление Rust reader с действующим Go на `a7d92d2852c4f6eb8afb0569ef76a545e38aacf7`. В README добавлена таблица реальных различий: пределы размера и режимы SHA-256, отмена, typed absence/причины ошибок, допустимые Windows-пути и отдельный inode/policy API. Пример потребителя `.inverse.json` показывает, почему простая замена reader нарушит обработку отсутствующего файла. Адаптер и производственные изменения не добавлены.

Исторические 15 нативных PASS не повторялись. Настоящие отказы stat/read/parent-close/final-close и сочетания основной ошибки с ошибками очистки остаются открытыми. Узкое сопоставление исходников снято с остатка; продуктовая интеграция и нативная квалификация сохраняются.

[Полное ревью и границы проверки](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/pull/627#pullrequestreview-5962470418). Новых Rust-сборок и тестов в этом проходе нет; заблокированные зависимости повторно не запрашивались. Полные обязательные Go-команды не квалифицированы. Слияния, объединения веток и установки не выполнялись.

Следующие записи сохраняют результаты **своих исторических исходников**, а не сообщают новые прогоны.

## Historical implementation and verification record

Следующее описание относится к прежнему head и сохраняется как история; текущая база и свежие проверки указаны выше.

## RX-04/read — отдельный read-only пилот из #623

**Не production reader и не замена Go API.** Семь новых файлов только в `experiments/rust-anchored-read/`; никаких изменений установки, состояния, vault, транзакций или зависимостей продукта. Это отдельная ответственность от process-owner #625 и relay #626.

[README и воспроизведение](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/blob/57f69575bbe2276f14e330ecd80249872d690f9a/experiments/rust-anchored-read/README.md)

### Реализованная граница

`read_verified(root, components, cap, expected_digest, canceled)` держит исходные native handles: root → относительный компонент → final file. Нет позднего pathname reopen. NT open с no-reparse, проверка атрибутов, bounded чтение и SHA-256 тех же возвращаемых байтов.

Один владелец каждого handle, не более двух удерживаемых одновременно; cleanup отдельно от primary failure. Один close-attempt, без повторного закрытия потенциально переиспользованного численного handle. Закрытие с ошибкой не возвращает успешные данные. Реальная инъекция ошибки CloseHandle ещё не квалифицирована.

Размер проверяется не только при stat: один sentinel-байт поверх оставшегося лимита обнаруживает рост. Буфер/чанк используют upstream zeroize; это не обещание стирания всех прежних копий или allocator history.

### Native evidence

Windows 11 build 26100 / x64, Rust 1.99.1, только уже кешированные `windows-sys=0.61.2`, `sha2=0.10.9`, `zeroize=1.9.0`; `--offline --locked`, без скачивания/установки.

**15 native tests прошли без пропусков:** Unicode/empty/exact bytes, invalid inputs, cancellation до open и между чтениями, wrong hash/oversize, directory/missing native error, reparse в root/его ancestor/промежуточном/конечном компоненте, замена пути до и после приобретения handle, рост после stat, exact-cap EOF, сохранение инъецированной phase-error и отсутствие роста handles на повторных success/failure.

Отрицательный stub обнаружен первоначальными тестами. Временное удаление sentinel-байта выявлено тестом роста; исходные байты восстановлены, все проверки повторены. **`clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` и `fmt --check` прошли.** Пользовательские файлы/секреты не читались. Symlink tests использовали уже доступную способность ОС, без elevation/настроек.

### Почему пока НЕ интегрируем

- Только drive-absolute Windows local paths; UNC/verbatim/device/network namespace не квалифицированы.
- Лимит 1 МиБ, ожидаемый digest уже разобран в 32 байта. Backup-specific cap и optional empty digest существующего Go API не реализованы: это **не drop-in parity**.
- Cancellation не прерывает уже заблокированный синхронный ReadFile; проверки выполняются между операциями.
- Нет Go/Python FFI, writer/lock/transaction engine, atomic content snapshot или нового полномочия на чтение.
- Не Windows возвращает Unsupported до эффекта; Linux/macOS native implementation/tests ещё нет.
- Нужны exact Go-contract comparison, native failure/close injection, дополнительная версия/FS qualification, независимое security/lifecycle review и применимые repo-gates.
- Нет измеренного speedup, memory improvement или преимущества над обновлённым Go-владельцем.

Исходный Go reader сверён на #616 `53645ec7170c9d56073ab5140dec865b23ce7c21`; затронутые reader-файлы без дельты относительно ранее просмотренного `92bc059c`. Новый commit основной ветки при интеграции перепроверяется.

**Draft без merge, CI/bot dispatch, provider/model run, изменения активных веток или установленного Хаба.** Fixtures и отрицательные прогоны сохраняются для review/trash-first disposition; только принадлежащие тесту каталоги.

648.head: 184104c186108b150d1183318c3f6791f2a4ba5f
648.title: fix(serena): own a compatible PyYAML build constraint
648.body:
## Problem

The pinned Serena revision `949a27ef1e5fda1a6e7b561e777bcece345c6ffd` uses PyYAML 6.0.2. On the existing Windows Python 3.14 interpreter, UV builds it from source; setuptools 84 changed the compiler-error contract that PyYAML's optional-extension fallback handles.

## Change

Own the fixed Windows constraint `setuptools<84\n` through the existing preparation and attempt owners. Bind its bytes and policy provenance before package identity is calculated, create and verify it relative to the original retained attempt directory, and retain a read-only handle excluding write/delete access while UV uses it. Incomplete original settlement retains the pin; native close failures remain visible. Only the install invocation receives `--build-constraint`, and its UV receipt must contain exactly the fixed constraint.

The new follow-up adds one Windows test file for that pin's finish/close receiver. It covers local preflight, missing native settlement, incomplete input/output settlement, an original no-child outcome, and a real protected-handle close refusal. Synthetic fixture ownership is explicit; a complete native receipt is obtained from the original contained runner.

Current head: [`184104c186108b150d1183318c3f6791f2a4ba5f`](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/commit/184104c186108b150d1183318c3f6791f2a4ba5f), one parent `fc4dc5c7145e4f4d709b91654ab4bc1fd7abe259`. The follow-up adds 200 test lines and changes no production file or dependency.

## R25 verification — 21 November 2026

The exact clean parent plus the one published, byte-identical overlay passed on Windows:

- Selected tests with the race detector, default and `test_state_path_env`: **12 test/subtest PASS, 4 root executions, 10 leaf executions and 2 package PASS; zero FAIL or SKIP**.
- `go build -overlay ... ./...` and `go vet -overlay ... ./...`: both exit 0.
- Source and overlay checks before/after matched. GitHub readback confirmed the exact new file, tree and single parent.

Candidate SHA-256: `d75864f7d0f8517249ae7a68317f94735cf4589327e1398a757ea120ef997f68`. Scope manifest: `c1bf5533cf6b94879c18ac9c70ccd006e0ea564c36ab59f46495fe94fdb06996`.

Own review covered requirements, correctness, native resource lifetime, compatibility and complexity; independent source review was supplementary. An earlier assertion was rejected before execution, and revision 2 failed compilation on a missing pinned-package constant. Those failures are retained separately. The published revision uses the documented test-local Windows SDK value and passed the checks above.

These are parent-plus-overlay results with exact publication readback, not a separately executed published-head run.

## Earlier evidence and remaining boundaries

The original focused implementation run recorded 12 roots, 52 leaf cases and API vet. A separate 14 November installation diagnostic with the fixed constraint installed 74 packages and three entrypoints, with setuptools 83.0.0 recorded by PyYAML. Those historical results remain bound to their recorded source and environment.

The [15 November integrated report](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/pull/653#issuecomment-6896966516) and [16 November readback](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/pull/653#issuecomment-6923787383) concern combined source `4c600ef464769e0766edf276408a5f89464f3433`, not this standalone head. Earlier failed stage06 remains FAIL with original settlement not established.

The new tests exercise the native finish/close receiver with real test-owned handles and an original empty Job. Complete acquisition, begin-use admission, publisher/namespace authority, successful child and installed Product lifecycle are still unqualified here. Full default/tagged Go suites and formal external approval are not established. The capture wrapper observes direct-child exit without proving a deadline or settlement for the entire process tree. Keep this PR in Draft.

References: [PyYAML 6.0.2 setup](https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/6.0.2/setup.py), [setuptools 84 compiler contract](https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/blob/v84.0.0/setuptools/_distutils/compilers/C/msvc.py), [setuptools 83](https://github.com/pypa/setuptools/blob/v83.0.0/setuptools/_distutils/compilers/C/msvc.py). Reassess the fixed constraint when the pinned dependency supports the newer contract.

658.body:

661.head: 23ed6b5c6a942812a72e345c5d886b3310e9017e
661.title: test(cli): require semantic Serena conflict validation failures
661.body:
## Problem

`TestMCPFrontV3_SerenaConflictClassifierMutationTable` currently accepts any non-nil reader or rollback error for its 30 malformed documents. An unrelated open, permission or JSON-decoding failure can therefore satisfy the negative assertion before the intended domain validator is reached. The existing pin-reader non-entry check does not exclude this earlier failure.

## Change

Require the specific domain validation failure from both the real anchored reader and rollback. Preserve all 34 cases and classifier expectations, all four valid cases, the real journal setup, `readerCalls == 0` and every original durable fixture write.

One existing function changes: **35 additions / 20 deletions**, no production file, import, API, dependency or global seam. Ten cases specify their earlier binding/identity/generation/operation failure; the remaining twenty require the existing authority-shape refusal. These gates have no suitable typed/sentinel errors, so the tests use narrow existing message fragments.

This independent test correction is based on master `a7d92d2852c4f6eb8afb0569ef76a545e38aacf7`. Neither current #637 nor #658 changes this file. Commit: [`23ed6b5c6a942812a72e345c5d886b3310e9017e`](https://github.com/applicate2628/mcp-local-hub/commit/23ed6b5c6a942812a72e345c5d886b3310e9017e).

## Verification — R25, 21 November 2026

Exact clean master source plus this pinned overlay passed on Windows:

- Installed `gofmt`: unchanged.
- Selected root with race detector, default and `test_state_path_env`: **70 test/subtest PASS, 2 root executions, 68 leaf executions and 2 package PASS; zero FAIL/SKIP**.
- `go build -overlay ... ./...` and `go vet -overlay ... ./...`: exit 0.
- Source and candidate observations before/after matched. Own review covered requirements, correctness, security, compatibility and complexity; independent source review was supplementary.

Candidate SHA-256: `91a326178b2e2f30be40b181dd4853cafe3c1ee3a0b56fb7406441d7c9619ba4`. Scope manifest: `cd167a9cda767b2e57e64d29f689a12819d86ca34052ea89e91cbc3078f17dd9`.

## Rejected experiment and boundaries

An earlier candidate replaced 30 durable fixture writes with ordinary writes. Its functional checks passed, but three root-duration samples were slower than the same-source control; the experiment did not establish a speedup. This PR retains the original writer and publishes only the stronger validation oracle. Original experiment bytes and outputs are preserved separately.

This corrects a test false-positive risk, not an observed production authorization bypass. The recorded tests ran on the exact parent plus the published overlay; they are not a separately executed published-head run. Full default/tagged suites, installed Product acceptance and formal external approval remain unestablished. The wrapper observes direct-child completion without whole-process-tree settlement/deadline proof. Keep this PR in Draft.
